programme.title: It Should Not Had Happened
programme.desc: A compelling documentary about unexpected events that leave deep marks on individuals and communities. Through emotional testimonies and real-life stories, the film explores tragedy, responsibility and the consequences of decisions made in critical moments. It reveals the strength of people who continue moving forward despite painful memories and experiences that should never have happened.

programme.title: Be close!
programme.desc: This is a documentary film dedicated to military chaplains of the Armed Forces of Ukraine, their journey, service, and mission. The film traces the development of the chaplaincy movement from the events of Maidan and the beginning of the Russian-Ukrainian war in 2014, when priests helped the military as volunteers, to the present day - the time when military chaplaincy became an official part of the Ukrainian army. The film shows that the main mission of a chaplain is to be with the military in the most difficult moments: on the front lines, in hospitals, in the rear. This is a story of spiritual support, humanity and faith, which helps to endure and maintain inner strength even in the darkest days of war.

programme.title: The bombing of Kakhovskaya Hydroelectric Power
programme.desc: Through personal testimonies, expert analysis, and archival footage, this documentary revisits a major disaster one year later. It explores the far-reaching human, economic, and environmental consequences, revealing how communities continue to cope with loss, disruption, and uncertainty. By examining both the immediate aftermath and the long-term recovery process, it offers a thoughtful and moving perspective on resilience in the face of tragedy.

programme.title: Doctors
programme.desc: War is not just a line of fire, but a continuous battle for every heartbeat. Documentary project "Doctors" tells the story of those who changed sterile operating rooms to smoky trenches, and white coats to military pixels. This is a story about titanic medics who, under fire, snatch their comrades from the hands of death. You will see the true value of every second, where professionalism borders on superhuman courage, and saving lives becomes the highest form of victory.

programme.title: The Paper City. Kherson a yer after liberation
programme.desc: Surviving months of brutal occupation, the people of Kherson held onto hope, kindness, and unwavering faith in freedom. One year after liberation, this deeply moving documentary shares raw memories from those who endured the darkest days. Through personal stories of defiance, waiting for the Ukrainian Armed Forces, and reviving a devastated city, witness an incredible testament to human resilience, unity, and an indestructible spirit.
